subject: Request to substitute a PEX alternate in lieu of the copper domestic water piping

messages.text: We're proposing a PEX alternate in lieu of the copper domestic water piping specified in Section 22 11 16 and want sign-off before we order material. No rush -- please take a look whenever it's convenient. No impact to the plumbing fixture budget is anticipated. No schedule impact is anticipated from this substitution. A response by the end of the day would let us keep the order on track.

The submittal for a PEX alternate in lieu of the copper domestic water piping specified in Section 22 11 16 is acceptable provided it shows equivalent performance data and code-compliance listings for the assembly it replaces. No impact to the plumbing fixture budget is anticipated.
